dinners.name: Spice-rubbed baked pork tenderloin
dinners.note: GF as written (recipe is 1 lb tenderloin, ~4 servings — leftovers for lunch). Check the chili and mustard powder labels. Roast sweet potato wedges and 1 broccoli bunch at 425°F alongside.

dinners.name: Honey garlic shrimp
dinners.note: Use GF tamari instead of soy sauce (the recipe's own GF note). Use the 340 g bag (~3/4 of the recipe). Serve over rice with steamed broccoli.

dinners.name: Keema curry with peas
dinners.note: Use the 454 g ground chicken instead of ground beef. Serve with rice, not naan. Check the curry powder label. Full recipe = dinner + 2 lunches.

dinners.name: Spicy peanut tofu bowls
dinners.note: Use GF tamari instead of soy sauce and check the sambal label. Halve the recipe: 1 block tofu, 1 broccoli bunch, 1 red pepper, 3/4 cup rice.

dinners.name: Sheet pan chicken fajitas
dinners.note: GF as written; serve in GF-labelled corn tortillas with avocado, lime and cilantro. Check the chili powder label. 1 lb chicken makes 2 dinners + leftovers. Thaw the fish tonight.

dinners.name: Greek baked cod
dinners.note: Naturally GF. Halve the recipe, using the 400 g bag of white fish fillets. Check the marinated artichoke label. Serve with the leftover rice or a green salad.

groceries.name: Fresh pork tenderloin (family-size cryovac)
groceries.note: Use one tenderloin Sunday; freeze the other. Plain (unmarinated) only.

groceries.name: Raw shrimp, 31–40/lb, 340 g (frozen)
groceries.note: Ad is Farm Boy™ brand; match depends on No Frills carrying it. Otherwise SeaQuest raw shrimp 300 g is $6.00 at No Frills.

groceries.name: Boneless skinless chicken breasts
groceries.note: Ad is a family size pack; freeze any extra.

groceries.name: SeaQuest fish fillets, 400 g (frozen)
groceries.note: Pick plain (unbreaded) cod or haddock. Thaw Thursday night.

groceries.name: Broccoli bunches
groceries.note: Sunday, Monday and Wednesday. No Frills crowns are $2.49 ea.

groceries.name: Sweet peppers, pkg of 4
groceries.note: 2 for the fajitas, 1 red for the tofu bowls, 1 spare.

groceries.name: Sambal oelek
groceries.note: Check the label for GF (Huy Fong is GF).
